name: Lisabelle no Ma 5 - Rygam Hen ~Omoi no Yukue~
original_name: リズベルルの魔5　リィガイム篇～想いの行方～
source:
"......A catastrophe will come. A dark, terrible disaster....."

Requiring the strength of Vilfona, swordmaster J'alvan Dredd entrusted Lisabelle and her party with a journey to the city of Rygam. Lisabelle was in high spirits about joining Noraurd, but found him but promised to another. She conducted herself admirably but all of a sudden Vilfona vanished-----.

Where would Lisabelle's feelings take her, and what would Vilfona do?

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE156766.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
“……灾难将至。黑暗、可怕的灾难……”

剑术大师贾尔万·德雷德需要维尔弗娜的力量，于是委托莉莎贝尔一行前往雷加姆城。莉莎贝尔因能与诺劳德同行而兴奋，却发现他已经许诺给别人。她仍然表现得体，但维尔弗娜突然消失了——

莉莎贝尔的感情会把她带向何方？维尔弗娜又会怎样？
